card.statement:
[A family of nontrivial Lie--Rinehart bimonoids] Let

\[
\mathcal C=s\mathcal{V}ec(\mathbb C)
\]

be the symmetric monoidal category of super vector spaces. Let

\[
A=\Lambda(\xi)=\mathbb C\oplus \mathbb C\xi
\]

be the exterior algebra generated by one odd element $\xi$, that is,

\[
|\xi|=\bar 1,
\qquad
\xi^2=0.
\]

We regard $A$ as a super-commutative bimonoid by setting

\[
\Delta(1)=1\otimes 1,
\qquad
\Delta(\xi)=\xi\otimes 1+1\otimes \xi,
\]

and

\[
\varepsilon(1)=1,
\qquad
\varepsilon(\xi)=0.
\]

The map $\Delta$ is an algebra homomorphism in $s\mathcal{V}ec(\mathbb C)$, since

\[
\Delta(\xi)^2
=
(\xi\otimes 1+1\otimes \xi)^2=0
\]

by the Koszul sign rule.

Define an even derivation

\[
d:A\longrightarrow A
\]

by

\[
d(1)=0,
\qquad
d(\xi)=\xi.
\]

Then $d$ is also a coderivation with respect to the above comonoid structure, namely

\[
\Delta\circ d
=
(d\otimes \id_A+\id_A\otimes d)\circ \Delta,
\qquad
\varepsilon\circ d=0.
\]

Let $\mathfrak g$ be an ordinary Lie algebra, regarded as concentrated in degree $\bar 0$, and let

\[
\chi:\mathfrak g\longrightarrow \mathbb C
\]

be a Lie algebra character, i.e.

\[
\chi([\mathfrak g,\mathfrak g])=0.
\]

Set

\[
L=A\otimes \mathfrak g.
\]

Then $L$ is naturally a left $A$-module via multiplication on the first factor:

\[
a\cdot (b\otimes x)=ab\otimes x,
\qquad
a,b\in A,\ x\in \mathfrak g.
\]

Define the anchor

\[
\alpha:L\otimes A\longrightarrow A
\]

by

\[
\alpha(a\otimes x,b)=a\,\chi(x)d(b),
\qquad
a,b\in A,\ x\in \mathfrak g.
\]

For homogeneous $a,b\in A$ and $x,y\in \mathfrak g$, define a bracket on $L$ by

\[
[a\otimes x,b\otimes y]
=
ab\otimes [x,y]
+
a\,\chi(x)d(b)\otimes y
-
(-1)^{|a||b|}
b\,\chi(y)d(a)\otimes x.
\]

Then $(A,L,\alpha)$ is a Lie--Rinehart bimonoid in $s\mathcal{V}ec(\mathbb C)$.
card.label: Example 37

paper.title: Categorical Lie-Rinehart modules and Shen-Larsson functors
paper.abstract: We develop a categorical framework for Lie-Rinehart monoids and their weak modules in a symmetric monoidal category. Using crossed homomorphisms, we construct a natural action of the monoidal category of modules over a Lie monoid on the category of weak Lie-Rinehart modules, thereby obtaining categorical versions of the Shen-Larsson functors. We further characterize the conditions under which the category of weak modules admits a monoidal structure and identify the corresponding condition for the associated functors to be strict monoidal. A dual theory for Lie- Rinehart comonoids and weak comodules is developed using cocrossed homomorphisms. Combining the module and comodule constructions, we obtain a bimodule category structure on the category of weak modules. Finally, we specialize the general framework to the symmetric monoidal category of super vector spaces, recovering Lie-Rinehart superalgebras and their associated Shen-Larsson-type constructions.
